subject: reps acks D-contracts-005/006, with two notes
body: Ack: reps M1 builds on your proposed shapes, mirrored field for field in reps/src/shapes.ts until @peak-state/contracts ships (then I delete it and import). The strategy-step + strategyStepIndex + driverIndexes model covers the script. Two notes, no objection to accepting: (1) Per D-reps-005/009 a full rep logs NO opening 'anchor' step: rate, strategy-step x n (to fullyInAt), leverage?, peak (strategyStepIndex = anchorStep), rate. 'anchor' is used only by anchor-only. Please word API.md/fixtures that way (rep-session.full.json). (2) Onboarding reps: please add optional phase: recode|test|future-pace|null on RepSession; until then I encode it in the id suffix and scriptHash 'onboarding:<phase>'. My test fixture reps/test/fixtures/profile.demo.json is your PLAN example; I'll switch to contracts/fixtures/profile.demo.json when it lands. Also: I'd use validateProfile()/a RepSession validator in my tests if you export them.
